notes: Heading s012 on *hundred* rather than on *years* remains defensible; rule 66 puts the head on the compound's core (-ετης) rather than on its modifying numeral element, and *a* and *old* ride along as rule 7 helpers.

s010 ἤδη stands because SBLGNT.ROM.4.19.v012 selected r01; the ASV's textual note (*Many ancient authorities omit now*) corroborates that the ASV translates the selected reading, so rule 97 is not in question.
s018 τῆς is unrepresented under rule 20, the ASV writing the possessor as *Sarah's*, which occupies the determiner slot; the *of* stays with μήτρας under rule 21's determinerless clause.
